title: Quest Foglight for Databases paFnUploadFileAndCreateInfo Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution… (CVE-2026-92186)
description: CVE-2026-92186 is a directory traversal vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases affecting the paFnUploadFileAndCreateInfo script. It allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied file paths.
